title: Field watch DHCP — observe only, not our DHCP
motto: We watch DHCP on the wire. We do not serve it. Foreign and incumbent servers are witnessed; our field-dhcp is separate authority.

why_we_did.summary: Field DHCP (field-dhcp.py) is our authority when we choose to serve. Field watch DHCP is a passive witness — it observes routers, ISP CPE, dnsmasq, and incumbents without binding port 67 or competing for leases.
reasons: Rogue or foreign DHCP must be seen before fleet protect and collision guard act.
Grow watch and planetary counts must not confuse our leases with observed LAN DHCP.
Automated poll keeps the panel live without operator babysitting.
